experiences.name: Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque Exploration
experiences.description: Spend a morning exploring the iconic Hagia Sophia, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that has served as a cathedral, mosque, and museum over 1,500 years. Walk across Sultanahmet Square to the stunning Blue Mosque with its six minarets and exquisite Iznik tile interior. Hire a local guide to uncover the layered Byzantine and Ottoman history embedded in every mosaic and minaret.

experiences.name: Grand Bazaar & Spice Market Food and Culture Walk
experiences.description: Wander through the Grand Bazaar, one of the world's oldest and largest covered markets with over 4,000 shops, then head to the Egyptian Spice Bazaar to sample Turkish delight, saffron, dried fruits, and aromatic spices. Engage with local vendors, taste free samples, and pick up authentic souvenirs. A self-guided or small-group tour brings the Ottoman merchant culture vividly to life.

experiences.name: Traditional Turkish Cooking Class
experiences.description: Join a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef in a traditional Istanbul kitchen. Learn to prepare classic dishes such as meze platters, stuffed grape leaves (dolma), lamb kebabs, and baklava from scratch. Classes typically include a visit to a local market to source fresh ingredients, followed by a communal meal with wine or tea. A deeply immersive way to connect with Turkish culinary heritage.

experiences.name: Topkapi Palace & Harem Tour
experiences.description: Explore the magnificent Topkapi Palace, the administrative heart of the Ottoman Empire for nearly 400 years. Walk through the Imperial Treasury housing the Topkapi Dagger and Spoonmaker's Diamond, stroll the lush courtyards, and take a guided tour of the Harem — the private royal quarters with over 400 rooms of ornate tilework and painted ceilings. The views of the Bosphorus from the palace terraces are breathtaking.

experiences.name: Bosphorus Sunset Cruise with Street Food Evening
experiences.description: Board a public or private Bosphorus ferry at sunset to glide between Europe and Asia, passing Ottoman palaces, ancient fortresses, and charming waterfront villages. After docking, explore the vibrant Karaköy or Beşiktaş waterfront for a classic Istanbul street food evening — grilled corn, simit (sesame bread rings), balık ekmek (fish sandwiches), and a glass of traditional ayran or çay at a local tea house.
experiences.location: Eminönü Ferry Docks to Bosphorus waterway
